Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Enter the valid username; 2. Enter the password; 3. Click Login

Title: Login with invalid password
Test Data: Public demo username and deliberately incorrect password
Steps: 1. Enter the username; 2. Enter the incorrect password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and an error message appears

Title: Add product to cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and inventory is displayed
Steps: 1. Click Add to cart for the selected product; 2. Open the shopping cart
Expected Result: Selected product appears in the cart

Title: Remove product from cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and one product is in the cart
Steps: 1. Open the shopping cart; 2. Click Remove for the selected product; 3. Verify the cart contents
Expected Result: Selected product is removed from the cart

Title: Sort products by price low-to-high
Preconditions: User is logged in and inventory is displayed
Steps: 1. Open the product sort dropdown; 2. Select Price (low to high); 3. Verify the displayed prices are in ascending order
Expected Result: Products are sorted by ascending price

Title: Checkout with required fields empty
Preconditions: User is logged in and has a product in the cart
Steps: 1. Open the cart; 2. Click Checkout; 3. Leave the required fields empty; 4. Click Continue
Expected Result: Checkout does not proceed and validation feedback appears

Title: Complete checkout
Preconditions: User is logged in and has a product in the cart
Test Data: Non-personal sample first name last name and postal code
Steps: 1. Open the cart; 2. Click Checkout; 3. Enter the required sample information; 4. Click Continue; 5. Review the order; 6. Click Finish

Title: Open product details
Preconditions: User is logged in and inventory is displayed
Steps: 1. Select a product name or image; 2. Verify the product details page; 3. Compare the displayed product with the selected item
